additionalInformation: Grants a total of 80 flat bonus attack damage at max charges.
description: A wicked weapon, used in torturing political criminals.
trivia: This item was named "Stygian Desolator" in DotA, a reference to an item from Anarchy Online. This name is now used by an upgraded version of the Desolator, which drops as a neutral item.
tips: Corruption works against buildings, making it a great pushing tool. Split-pushing heroes can benefit a lot from it, allowing them to take towers down much quicker.
The debuff lasts quite long, so sometimes it is better to get the debuff on multiple enemies, instead of focusing only one target in team fights.
recommendedFor: Arc Warden, his File:ArcWardenUltPng.jpeg Tempest Double clone, and his Manta Style Illusions are able to push buildings much more quickly, as well as enemy heroes with the benefit of Desolator's armor reduction
Bounty Hunter sometimes buys a Desolator to land one hard hit on enemies with Jinada, debuffing them in teamfights before retreating
Juggernaut sometimes opts for a Desolator to reduce an opponents armor before using Omnislash
Pantheon can use Desolator to reduce the armor of every unit hit by God's Rebuke and increase its damage output
Nature's Prophet's low damage benefits from Desolator's armor reduction
Tusk hits exceptionally hard with Walrus PUNCH! after Desolator's armor reduction
Ursa's damage through Fury Swipes is greatly increased with Desolator's armor reduction

abilities.description: Your attacks reduce the target's armor by -6 for 7 seconds.
Desolator gains +2 damage every time an enemy hero dies while affected by Corruption, to a maximum of 30.

name: Desolator
